rules.statement: When a method returns a rented buffer lease together with a span or memory view over it, its `///` doc comment (`<summary>`, `<param>`, `<returns>`) states that the caller owns and must dispose the lease and that the view is read-only and valid only until the lease is disposed; private helpers are included.
rules.why: Without it the helper doesn't tell callers who owns the returned lease or how long the view stays valid, and the XML documentation convention gives every member whose signature changes a `///` comment, private helpers included.
rules.check: Look for new or changed methods, private ones included, that return or `out` a lease (IDisposable/IMemoryOwner/rented buffer) plus a ReadOnlySpan/Memory view. Report any that have no `///` docs, or only `//` comments, or docs that don't say who disposes the lease and how long the view stays valid.
